title: Data
text: The STATE_COORDS constant contains coordinate grid positions for all US states, DC, Puerto Rico, Virgin Islands, and New York City.

title: StateBins.jl
text: A Julia package for creating statebins (state binned choropleth maps) visualizations.

title: Overview
text: StateBins provide an alternative to traditional geographic maps by representing each US state as an equally-sized square arranged in a grid that roughly approximates the geographic layout of the United States. This approach offers several advantages: Equal visual weight: Each state gets the same …

title: Quick Example
text:
using StateBins, DataFrames, CairoMakie

data = DataFrame(
    state = ["CA", "TX", "FL", "NY", "PA"],
    value = [39.5, 29.7, 22.6, 19.3, 13.0]
)

statebins(data; title="State Population (millions)")
